description.en: Build reusable character references, portraits, and variant sets.
description.zh: 生成可复用的角色参考、肖像和变体组。

description.zh: 把创意组织成可执行的 prompt-only 视频镜头计划。

skills.name: character-creation

summary.en: Start from a character description, generate a few visual directions, and let the agent score and keep the strongest image as a reusable character reference.
summary.zh: 输入角色描述，生成若干视觉方向，由 Agent 打分并保留最强结果作为可复用角色参考。

bestFor.en: Game characters, AI comic casts, reference portraits, and style exploration.
bestFor.zh: 游戏角色、AI 漫剧演员、参考肖像和风格探索。

skills.install: npx skills add leozejia/sorryassets-skills --skill character-creation -a codex -a claude-code -g -y

note.en: Preview contract only; real image E2E belongs to E1.
note.zh: 仅为预览契约；真实图片 E2E 属于 E1。

skills.name: short-drama

summary.en: Turn one premise into a 30-second episode: script, cast, two shots, planning stills, two prompt-only 15s clips, and one assembled local MP4.
summary.zh: 把一句创意做成 30 秒短剧：剧本、角色、两镜分镜、规划静帧、两段 prompt-only 15 秒镜头，并本地拼成一条 MP4。

bestFor.en: Autonomous 30-second short-drama production on SorryAssets desktop MCP.
bestFor.zh: 在 SorryAssets 桌面 MCP 上自主完成 30 秒短剧生产。

skills.install: npx skills add leozejia/sorryassets-skills --skill short-drama -a codex -a claude-code -g -y

installTargets.claudeCode: npx skills add leozejia/sorryassets-skills --skill short-drama -a claude-code -g -y

note.en: Agent chooses intermediates; video is prompt-only 15s 720p 9:16; assembly is local FFmpeg.
note.zh: 中间选择由 Agent 完成；视频为 prompt-only 15s 720p 9:16；拼装使用本地 FFmpeg。
